rubric.role_summary: Senior game designer for a new project in Shanghai, designing and implementing gameplay features, combat encounters, enemies, and level content in Unreal Engine.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior game designer for a new project in Shanghai, designing and implementing gameplay features, combat encounters, enemies, and level content in Unreal Engine.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 7+ years of professional experience as a gameplay or game designer.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Demonstrable experience crafting second-to-second action gameplay, such as level mechanics, layout design, or enemy/AI behavior.
- Familiarity with level design tools and concepts and a proven track record of building level blockouts.
- Experience with combat AI and familiarity with Unreal Behavior Trees.
- Extensive knowledge of Unreal's GAS, from Gameplay Effects to Ability Modifiers.
- At least 7 years of professional experience as a Gameplay Designer, including combat gameplay and/or level content created in Unreal Engine and Blueprint.
- Proven ability to implement enemies, NPCs, and combat mechanics into encounters.
- Ability to independently design new features and systems and support their implementation.
- Experience using AI in day-to-day work.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Shanghai, China area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas. Relocation is offered; candidates outside these areas may qualify with explicit evidence of willingness to relocate. Current residence in the area is not mandatory.
